items.title: Define a command-local evidence hash snapshot contract
items.context: Add or expose a narrow primitive that captures HEAD/materialHash/storyFilesHash with enough git-state context to prevent stale reuse. It must be host-neutral and must not be a persistent cache.

happy.desc: captureEvidenceHashSnapshot returns one coherent headHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash binding for the same git cwd and metadata root

edge.desc: the snapshot records material dirty state so dirty material worktree changes cannot be silently reused

adversarial.desc: the contract exposes no persistent cache and no mtime or file-count based freshness shortcut

items.title: Thread the snapshot through DONE and review assurance consumers
items.context: Consumers that already operate within one command/gate run should reuse the same captured binding instead of recomputing currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash independently, while retaining stale checks at gate boundaries.

items.title: Prove reuse does not admit stale evidence
items.context: Add focused regression coverage for unchanged-state reuse and changed-state invalidation: HEAD drift, dirty worktree/index drift, and story-owned file drift must all force a fresh binding or fail stale checks.

happy.desc: focused smoke coverage proves unchanged-state snapshot reuse passes

edge.desc: focused smoke coverage proves story-owned file drift changes storyFilesHash and blocks stale evidence

adversarial.desc: focused smoke coverage proves dirty material worktree state prevents unsafe snapshot reuse

items.title: Document the syndrome-preflight boundary
items.context: Record why this is a safe Proofbound optimization: exact hash-bound evidence remains authoritative, no mtime cache, no erasure-code recovery, and no global cache semantics.
